sources_used: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?list=geosearch (10 km radius around Tekapo and 3 offset centres)
https://www.doc.govt.nz (popular places page and search returned nothing usable for Tekapo)

gaps.name: Sheepdog Statue
gaps.reason: Named in Wikipedia's Attractions section and Wikivoyage See (Church of the Good Shepherd entry); a famous bronze beside the church that every visitor photographs. Distinct stop from the church, 100 m away.

gaps.name: Mount John Walkway
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage Do/Tramping lists it with a 3 hour return; DOC-signed track from the town to the summit. A separate, free alternative to the observatory spot (which is the summit), so not a duplicate.

gaps.name: Lake Tekapo Regional Park
gaps.reason: Wikipedia attractions section and the managing agency (Environment Canterbury) page: 165 ha with 24 km of walking and cycling tracks, picnic areas, reached on foot or bike from the village.

gaps.name: Lake Alexandrina
gaps.reason: Wikipedia article, sealed road access about 10 km north of the village, wildlife refuge and fishing lake beside Lake McGregor; a plausible second-tier stop. Only one source and marginal, so a human may drop it.

gaps.name: Burkes Pass
gaps.reason: Wikipedia and Wikivoyage articles; small village with cafe, antique shops and Burke memorial on the road in from Fairlie/Timaru, about 17 km from Tekapo, inside the 75% span (18.75 km). Marginal; a roadside stop.

gaps.name: Peninsula Walkway
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage only, no article or DOC page, closed October to December for lambing, rarely signed; an obscure local walk.

gaps.name: Parkbrae Estate
gaps.reason: Private garden operator open limited hours, no article; an operator, not a general stop.

gaps.name: Lake Tekapo Footbridge
gaps.reason: A 125 m path linking the church to the village, part of the church stop rather than a place to go.

gaps.name: Cowan's Hill Observatory
gaps.reason: A tour-only site of the Dark Sky Project; the operator and its Mount John spot already cover it.

gaps.name: Tekapo Hot Springs
gaps.reason: Duplicate of existing spot Tekapo Springs.

gaps.name: Lake McGregor
gaps.reason: Small shallow lake beside Lake Alexandrina with no visitor facilities or mention by any guide; covered by the Lake Alexandrina stop.

gaps.name: Lake George Scott
gaps.reason: Wikipedia geosearch hit only; small pond in the village, not a destination.

gaps.name: Tekapo A Power Station / Tekapo Canal
gaps.reason: Hydro infrastructure mentioned in history only; no visitor access or guide listing.

gaps.name: Tekapo Military Camp
gaps.reason: Active training base, not open to visitors.

gaps.name: Roundhill Ski Area
gaps.reason: 32 km away, outside the span, seasonal operator-run ski area reached from Tekapo only in winter. Human could add as a standalone spot if skifields are wanted.

gaps.name: Mount Dobson Ski Field
gaps.reason: About 40 km away, outside the span, seasonal operator; as for Roundhill.

gaps.name: Lake Pukaki
gaps.reason: Already a spot (of Aoraki / Mount Cook National Park), about 25 km from Tekapo and outside its span.

gaps.name: Twizel
gaps.reason: About 60 km away; a town that may deserve its own destination (not in destinations.ts) but outside this destination. Flag for the south-island pass.

gaps.name: Tekapo air and heli scenic flights; kayaking; bike hire; salmon farm tours
gaps.reason: Operators and activities, not places.

gaps.name: Aoraki Mackenzie International Dark Sky Reserve
gaps.reason: A 430,000 ha designation, not a place to stand; stargazing is covered by Mount John Observatory and Dark Sky Project.

existing_fixes.to: Keep as a place (the Dark Sky Project lakefront building at 1 Motuariki Lane), but rewrite the bio to name the lakefront centre rather than the Mount John tours, e.g. 'The lakefront astronomy centre of the Dark Sky Project, where guided night-sky tours depart for Mount John and a daytime exhibit explains the dark-sky reserve.' Avoid an operator-only spot.
existing_fixes.reason: Near-duplicate of lake-tekapo-2 (Mount John University Observatory): the bio describes the same stargazing tours at Mount John. Operator-like, so keep it distinct as the lakefront centre or remove if reviewers prefer one stargazing spot. Wikivoyage lists tours via Dark Sky Project at 1 Motuariki Lane, 10AM-late.
Optional: Wikivoyage names it Mount John Observatory; current name is acceptable. No change required, leave if unsure.

new_spots.name: Sheepdog Statue
new_spots.coordinates_source: Wikimedia Commons geotag of File:Lake Tekapo Sheepdog Statue 002.JPG (-44.00365898, 170.48417974), consistent with a second Commons geotag at -44.003403, 170.483801
new_spots.bio: A bronze statue of a New Zealand collie on a rock plinth beside the Church of the Good Shepherd, put up by Mackenzie Country residents in honour of the sheepdogs that high-country farming depends on.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No steward or official site; open-air memorial.

new_spots.name: Mount John Walkway
new_spots.coordinates_source: Trailhead at the signed DOC start by Tekapo Springs: Commons geotag of File:Mt. John Walkway - 2013.04 - panoramio.jpg (-43.994765, 170.460388), consistent with OSM Nominatim 'Mount John Walkway' track at -43.9941, 170.4672
new_spots.bio: A track from beside Tekapo Springs up through forest and tussock to the Mount John summit, with panoramic views of the lake and an allow-3-hours return.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: DOC's Mt John Walkway deep links tried (/places-to-go/canterbury/places/mt-john-walkway/ and a lake-tekapo-area guess) returned 404; no page confirmed, left null.

new_spots.name: Lake Tekapo Regional Park
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim boundary=protected_area 'Takapō Regional Park' centroid (-44.0049276, 170.5079189); Wikipedia gives -44.0083, 170.5. Centroid of the park, not an entrance (access is on foot or bike from the village or by car from Lilybank Road); verify with the audit script.
new_spots.bio: A 165-hectare Environment Canterbury park on the eastern lakeshore with picnic areas, a dog exercise park and 24 km of walking and cycling tracks.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded the page: HTML title 'Takapō Regional Park | Environment Canterbury' and h1 'Takapō Regional Park'; the managing agency's page.

new_spots.name: Lake Alexandrina
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim natural=water 'Lake Alexandrina' (-43.9381889, 170.4525482); Wikipedia gives a rounded -43.95, 170.45. Lake centroid, in the water, which is correct for a lake.
new_spots.bio: A shallow glacial wildlife-refuge lake in the Mackenzie Basin, spring fed and known for brown and rainbow trout and salmon fishing, just north of Lake Tekapo.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No official visitor site for the lake; omitted.

new_spots.name: Burkes Pass
new_spots.coordinates_source: OSM Nominatim place=hamlet 'Burkes Pass' (-44.0894425, 170.6527866), matching Commons geotags of the village street (-44.089, 170.653); Wikipedia's -44.09, 170.6 is the pass saddle with the Burke memorial, 5 km west.
new_spots.bio: A small village at the gateway to the Mackenzie Country, named for Michael Burke who drove bullocks through the pass in 1855, with a cafe and roadside shops on State Highway 8.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Village with no single steward; omitted.
